doc: The same edge ties on a float64 image: the edges are then float64 k * 0.1 (7 * 0.1 = 0.7000000000000001, so the literal 0.7 falls in bin 6, not 7). np.histogram bins [edge_k, edge_k+1), the last bin closed, edges = linspace(0, 1, bins + 1) computed in float64 (k * (1 / bins)) and rounded to the IMAGE dtype (float32 edges for a float32 image); values outside [0, 1] are dropped; weights cos(lat) in float64, normalized by their sum. Weighted float64 sums: 1e-9.
